title: RENEGADES: Daniel K. Inouye: Life of Service
original_title: RENEGADES: Daniel K. Inouye: Life of Service
overview: Explore the story of the U.S. Senator for Hawai'i who was injured in battle during World War II, resulting in the amputation of his right arm. Posthumously awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom for his lifelong public service, Inouye championed the cause of justice and equality for all Americans, including people living with disabilities.
